title: Biology
description: ICSE Class IX Biology: one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks internal assessment of practical work.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Biology (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Basic Biology; Flowering Plants; Plant Physiology; Diversity in Animal Kingdom; Economic Importance of Bacteria and Fungi; Human Anatomy and Physiology.

sections.title: Biology
sections.description: Six units from cell biology to human physiology.

chapters.title: The Cell: A Unit of Life
chapters.blurb: Cell theory, organelles, prokaryote vs eukaryote, plant vs animal cell.

chapters.title: Tissues
chapters.blurb: Types, location, structure and functions of plant and animal tissues.

chapters.title: The Flower
chapters.blurb: Bisexual flower structure, whorls, inflorescence and placentation.

chapters.title: Pollination and Fertilisation
chapters.blurb: Self vs cross pollination, agents, double fertilisation, fruit and seed.

chapters.title: Seeds and Germination
chapters.blurb: Bean seed and maize grain, monocot vs dicot, hypogeal vs epigeal germination.

chapters.title: Respiration in Plants
chapters.blurb: Outline of glycolysis and Krebs cycle, aerobic vs anaerobic respiration, experiments.

chapters.title: Absorption by Roots
chapters.blurb: Diffusion, osmosis, turgid and flaccid cells, plasmolysis, imbibition, root pressure.

chapters.title: Transpiration
chapters.blurb: Stomata, types of transpiration, factors, ganong potometer, significance and adaptations.

chapters.title: Diversity in Animal Kingdom
chapters.blurb: Non-chordates from Porifera to Echinodermata and the five classes of chordates.

chapters.title: Economic Importance of Bacteria and Fungi
chapters.blurb: Useful and harmful roles of bacteria; useful role of fungi.

chapters.title: Nutrition
chapters.blurb: Classes of food, balanced diet, deficiency diseases, tooth structure, digestive system.
